data.title: Hillmont Residences
data.about:
In the scenic enclave of Jumeirah Village Circle, Ellington proudly unveils Hillmont Residences, a beacon of contemporary urban living that harmoniously blends with the locale's distinctive circular layout. The project's thoughtful design is a hallmark of Ellington Hillmont Residences, capturing the essence of the community it serves. The façade of Hillmont Residences JVC is a testament to how architectural thoughtfulness can celebrate the community's diversity, utilizing a strategic mix of materials and textures to reflect the character of JVC in every detail.

Offering an array of apartment types, the Hillmont Residences Apartments are situated within a towering 12-floor structure. These include a selection of studios, 1, 2 and 3 bedroom layouts, making Apartments for sale at Ellington Hillmont Residences a coveted choice for those seeking a blend of community and privacy. Hillmont Residences stand out as an emblem of modern sophistication and everlasting charm in JVC.

The entrance lobby of Hillmont Residences sets a tone of elegance and hospitality, centered around a magnificent marble reception desk. The Lobby Lounge, inspired by luxury hospitality concepts, features diverse seating options for relaxation, socialization, and productivity, enriched by the Ellington Art Foundation's handpicked, locally inspired art pieces. This attention to detail ensures that Hillmont Residences JVC offers a welcoming atmosphere to all who enter, making every moment within its walls a testament to thoughtfully designed luxury.
